# Hillary Richards

> Portfolio of Hillary Richards, a Kenyan web and app developer building modern websites, applications and creative digital experiences.

Hillary Richards is a 23-year-old web developer, app developer and creative technologist based in Kenya. This site is a single-page portfolio covering background, selected projects and contact details.

## Sections

- Home — introduction and hero statement
- About — background and areas of focus
- Work — selected projects, including DropZone (a temporary digital event space), Baptist Church Kayole (church website), Horizon School Website, and Halisi Academy (school website)
- Skills — development, backend/data, application development, design and media technology tools
- Contact — project inquiries via hillaryrichard2865@gmail.com

## Notes for crawlers and agents

- This is a single HTML page; all sections above are anchors on the same URL (`/#about`, `/#work`, `/#skills`, `/#contact`).
- Do not infer client names, employment history, testimonials, or statistics beyond what is stated on the page — none are published, and none should be assumed.
